messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: missing heartbeat from region atl1 for 3 consecutive probes. metric: region-heartbeat.lost count=3

alex.k: seeing a spike in 502/504s from customers routed to atl1, thanks for the ping. can someone confirm control plane reachability?

mira.s: checking now. curl to controlplane endpoint times out. `curl -m 5 https://controlplane-atl1.internal/health` -> no response. API gateway health also showing 502s in grafana.

sanjay: I can see nodes flapping in prom: `node_health{region="atl1"} = 0` for a bunch of hostnames. GPU nodes show `NotReady` and kubelet not updating status.

jess: starting an emergency traffic shift plan to reduce load on atl1. proposing split: 60% -> iad4, 40% -> sfo3 for now. will open the routing change and update the loadbalancer policy.

leo: pinging cloud provider support now to check if there's an underlying fabric issue in atl1. sharing ticket once created.

mira.s: quick cluster snapshot: `kubectl get nodes -l region=atl1 -o wide` ->
```
gnode-122   NotReady   3d   192.0.2.122   gpu: 0/8
gnode-125   NotReady   2h   192.0.2.125   gpu: 0/4
gnode-130   Ready      10d  192.0.2.130   gpu: 8/8
```
Two control plane pods show CrashLoopBackOff on etcd sidecar, logs contain repeated `connection refused` to 127.0.0.1:2380.

alex.k: can we failover control plane? We have cross-region replicas but we need to ensure KV consistency — recommend opening read-only fallback and shift inference traffic to model-serving replicas in iad4/sfo3.

jess: executing Route change now. Will start by updating edge weights and enabling circuit-breaker for atl1. command: `curl -X POST https://edge-api.internal/reroute -d '{"region_weights": {"atl1":0.0, "iad4":0.6, "sfo3":0.4}}'`

sanjay: running network checks in region: `ip route show` and `traceroute` indicate packet loss inside provider fabric, multiple hops dropping. also seeing BGP flap logs from spine VTEP.

leo: provider support replied: "We are investigating degraded fabric in atl1, datacenter-level packet loss impacting management plane. Engineers on-site." Ticket #ATL-34921. ETA unknown.

mira.s: can someone cut KV writes to atl1 control plane to avoid split-brain while we shift? prefer to fence the local etcd.

alex.k: agreed. mira take fencing. jess continue traffic shift. sanjay keep probing infra layer. leo keep vendor comms and escalate to oncall escalation path.

mira.s: fenced local etcd instance: `etcdctl member remove <member-id>` (executed), confirming removed from quorum. cluster in other regions reports healthy quorum.

jess: edge weights updated, circuit-breaker active for atl1, starting slow ramp to move active sessions off region. :thumbsup: 

sanjay: GPU workload eviction observed: autoscaler triggered massive eviction of pods in atl1 earlier causing backlog. we should consider re-queueing long-running jobs and restartservable workers in target regions.

leo: raised priority with provider and asked for network fabric trace. posted ticket link in #vendors.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-ATL1-01. Severity: Sev2. Pager rotation: oncall-eng -> alex.k -> mira.s.

alex.k: next steps: 1) keep traffic off atl1 until provider confirms fabric healthy; 2) monitor model-serving latencies in iad4/sfo3 and scale if needed; 3) validate no customer data path touched in fencing.

mira.s: performing post-fence verification, control plane reads/writes now go to cross-region leader, cluster state consistent. will run control tests and circle back in 15m.

jess: ongoing: job to reschedule GPU workloads to other regions queued. hitting some quota limits in iad4; opening quick quota request.

sanjay: capturing diagnostic bundle: `/usr/local/bin/collect-region-diagnostics --region atl1 --output /tmp/atl1-diagnostics.tar.gz` and uploading to secure bucket. link: https://secure.internal/diag/atl1/3312345678

leo: provider escalated to "network fabric team" with high priority. they asked for pcap from host gnode-125, collecting now.

mira.s: control tests passed in cross-region leader. no split-brain. will keep region fenced until provider greenlights.

alex.k: thanks all — keep updates in this thread. if provider gives ETA, we’ll coordinate customer comms and potential credits. :eyes:
